name: Haria Exports Limited
about: Haria Exports Limited engages in trading of textiles and fabrics in India. The company is involved in the manufacture and export of garments, including apparel and clothing, cushions and bedcovers, napkins, table linen, towels, readymade garments, uniforms, athletic sportswear, curtains, knitted garments, industrial fabrics, accessories and material supplies, promotional caps, and t-shirts for men, women, and children; and the manufacture of notebooks under the Haria brand. It also provides advisory services for negotiations, project identification, management restructuring, documentation, foreign investments in India, liaison and representative offices, customs, FEMA and cross-border trade-related issues, service tax related matters, excise consultancy, human resource management, business partners/associates identification, joint ventures and collaborations, corporate governance, SEBI guidelines and securities market, company secretaries services, financial and corporate restructuring, mergers/de-mergers, and amalgamations. In addition, the company offers arbitration and mediation services, including conciliation and mediation, counseling, acting as arbitrators, carrying arbitration proceedings, and appearing before arbitral tribunals; and due diligence services, such as pre-investment due diligence of target companies/business entities, search reports and pre-investment audits, audits for non-government organizations and societies, audits for trusts, and corporate governance and corporate social responsibility audits. Further, it provides commercial and business contracts; litigation; and licensing services. Haria Exports Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Mumbai, India.
